items.description: This coral stone mosque, built in 1656, is the oldest in the Maldives and displays intricate carvings. It is a UNESCO World Heritage site candidate known for its unique architectural style.

A popular private island resort in Baa Atoll, Reethi Beach is famous for its white sandy shores and turquoise lagoon. The island offers a classic Maldivian tropical atmosphere with vibrant coral reefs.

Hulhumalé beach is an accessible, man-made stretch of sand connected to the capital island by a causeway. It is a popular spot for both locals and travelers seeking recreational activities near the airport.

Located in North Malé Atoll, Vabbinfaru is a small, pristine coral island known for its circular shape and clear waters. The beach encircles the entire island, providing constant access to the lagoon.
Nika Island is recognized for its unique privacy, with private beach areas for many villas. It features lush tropical vegetation and a preserved house reef perfect for snorkeling.
Meeru Island is one of the largest resorts in the Maldives, offering long stretches of white sandy beach. It is well-known for its extensive facilities and diverse water sports activities.
Thoddoo is an agricultural island in North Ari Atoll, known for its watermelon production and locally accessible beaches. The island provides a mix of local village life and stunning sandy coastline.
Omadhoo is a traditional fishing island in South Ari Atoll, offering an authentic glimpse into Maldivian life. The beach is scenic, quiet, and popular for spotting whale sharks in nearby waters.
Kuredu is a vibrant island in Lhaviyani Atoll famous for its long, iconic sandbank stretching into the ocean. It features a wide variety of amenities and extensive beach areas.
Fihalhohi is a compact island resort in South Malé Atoll known for its lush palm trees and tranquil beach. It provides a peaceful retreat with easy access to surrounding house reefs.
Ihuru is a tiny, circular island in North Malé Atoll, often referred to as one of the best for snorkeling. Its beach is clean and provides direct access to a spectacular, well-preserved reef.
